   105	def copular_control_declarations(text, policy):
   106	    """Recognize bounded literal declarations, not arbitrary prose role guesses.
   107	
   108	    Source text can say A and B are links without quoting either name. Losing
   109	    that declaration while retaining a scenario's quoted visual-tab shorthand
   110	    incorrectly turns an ambiguous role into a mandatory ARIA tab. Preserve both
   111	    pieces of evidence so the existing conflict rule can leave it unverified.
   112	    """
   113	    for clause in re.split(r'[.!?;\n]', text):
   114	        declaration = clause.strip()
   115	        match = re.fullmatch(r'(.+?)\s+(?:is|are)\s+(?:an?\s+)?(links?|buttons?|tabs?)', declaration, re.I)
   116	        if not match or re.match(r'(?:if|when|unless|provided|while|after|before)\b', declaration, re.I):
   117	            continue
   118	        names, role = match.groups()
   119	        literals = []
   120	        def protect(quoted):
   121	            literals.append(quoted[1])
   122	            return '\x00' + str(len(literals) - 1) + '\x00'
   123	        for opening, closing in policy['quote_pairs']:
   124	            names = re.sub(re.escape(opening) + r'([^\n]+?)' + re.escape(closing), protect, names)
   125	        names = re.sub(r'^(?:the|an?)\s+', '', names, flags=re.I)
   126	        pieces = re.split(r',\s*(?:and\s+)?|\s+and\s+', names, flags=re.I)
   127	        if not 1 <= len(pieces) <= 8:
   128	            continue
   129	        declared = []
   130	        for piece in pieces:
   131	            piece = piece.strip()
   132	            reference = re.fullmatch(r'\x00(\d+)\x00', piece)
   133	            if reference:
   134	                label = literals[int(reference[1])]
   135	            elif re.fullmatch(r'[\w][\w -]{0,80}', piece):
   136	                label = piece
   137	            else:
   138	                break
   139	            if not label.strip():
   140	                break
   141	            declared.append(label)
   142	        else:
   143	            for label in declared:
   144	                yield label, policy['roles'][role.lower()], declaration

   147	def compile_runtime_contracts(acceptance):

   152	    action_pattern=re.compile(policy['action_before_name_pattern'],re.I)

   155	             for key,req in acceptance['requirements'].items()]
   156	    for key,case in acceptance.get('cases',{}).items():

   159	    result={}
   160	    for req,path,text in sources:
   161	        for name,role,quote in copular_control_declarations(text, policy):
   162	            key=sha256(f'{req}:{role}:{name}'.encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
   163	            source={'source_path':path,'source_quote':quote}
   164	            if key in result:
   165	                if source not in result[key]['sources']: result[key]['sources'].append(source)
   166	            else:

   170	        if sidebar and not re.search(policy['navigation_collapse_negative_pattern'],sidebar[0],re.I):

   173	                         'source_path':path,'source_quote':text}
   174	        for opening,closing in policy['quote_pairs']:

   176	            for match in pattern.finditer(text):
   177	                prefix,suffix=text[:match.start()],text[match.end():]
   178	                explicit=after_role.search(suffix) or before_role.search(prefix)

   181	                if action and negative.search(prefix[:action.start()]): continue
   182	                role=policy['roles'][explicit['role'].lower()] if explicit else 'unknown'
   183	                # Neither side of a tab/button alternative is mandatory. A
   184	                # negative/optional suffix also cannot create a positive tab
   185	                # contract. Ignore the quoted name while examining this clause.
   186	                if role in {'tab','button'}:
   187	                    clause=re.split(r'[.!?;\n]',prefix)[-1]+' '+re.split(r'[.!?;\n]',suffix)[0]

   193	                # Different actions retain separate provenance; never silently turn
   194	                # a role inferred from generated DOM into an input requirement.
   195	                identity=f'{req}:{role}:{name}' + (f':{source_action}' if source_action else '')
   196	                key=sha256(identity.encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
   197	                source={'source_path':path,'source_quote':text}
   198	                if key in result:
   199	                    if source not in result[key]['sources']: result[key]['sources'].append(source)
   200	                else:
   201	                    result[key]={'id':key,'req_id':req,'role':role,'name':name,'action':source_action,
   202	                                 **source,'sources':[source]}
   203	    explicit=[c for c in result.values() if c['role']!='unknown']
   204	    for contract in result.values():
   205	        if contract['role']!='unknown' or contract.get('kind'): continue
   206	        owners={contract['req_id'],*acceptance['requirements'][contract['req_id']].get('ancestors',[])}
   207	        evidence=[c for c in explicit if c['req_id'] in owners and c['name']==contract['name']]
   208	        roles={c['role'] for c in evidence}
   209	        if evidence:
   210	            contract['role_evidence']=[{k:c[k] for k in ('req_id','role','source_path','source_quote')} for c in evidence]
   211	        if len(roles)==1: contract['role']=next(iter(roles))
   212	        elif len(roles)>1: contract['role_conflict']=sorted(roles)
   213	    return list(result.values())

    63	- Use competition Sidebar for icon-only navigation. Supply name/toggleName/items from
    64	  this input; each item has name/to/icon and optional role="link". All entries stay
    65	  accessible when collapsed, including dynamically loaded labels or groups. Its
    66	  default container is complementary; use role="navigation" when specified.
    67	  Handwritten sidebars must satisfy the same expanded/collapsed entry invariant.
    68	- TextField labels its input; NamedForm and Dialog accept `name`; RecordCard uses
    69	  the current record's identity as its accessible name. Put operation controls
    70	  inside the intended container. Use Dialog only for a real modal, not an inline
    71	  editor. Supply close/save/cancel controls from the current requirement and update
    72	  its `open` state in `onClose`. Native dialog manages modality and focus.
    73	- Disclosure's default is collapsed; use defaultOpen when the YAML specifies an
    74	  initially open section. ActionMenu supports openOnHover explicitly; hover followed
    75	  by click must keep actions accessible. AsyncCheckbox updates immediately, prevents
    76	  duplicate pending requests, and rolls back on failure: provide persisted checked,
    77	  onCommit and visible error handling via onError. Never let slow network refresh
    78	  undo a click before the request completes.
    79	- Use Menu only for an actual menu: it owns menuitem buttons and keyboard focus
    80	  (arrows/Home/End/Escape/Tab). ActionMenu remains a popover of normal action buttons.
    81	  Do not place role=menuitem inside an ordinary list with no menu parent. ToggleGroup
    82	  keeps option names stable and exposes aria-pressed; use current-YAML names and
    83	  values, not a single ambiguous label that silently changes with state.
    84	- Controller checkpoints inspect source after each module without reinstalling or
    85	  rebuilding. Fix their findings during the next existing turn. Final independent
    86	  checks run after dependencies are installed. Dynamic names/unvisited states are
    87	  not certified by static success; cover them with real browser interactions.
    88	
    89	## Initial state comes from this input
    90	
    91	- Read every ancestor description and original GIVEN/WHEN/THEN. Explicit Seed
    92	  declarations apply even inside scenario steps; the module's deduplicated
    93	  seed_contracts preserves their text, owners and case IDs. Provision the stated
    94	  objects/relations for those scenarios; keep different owner/name pairs distinct.
    95	  An ordinary GIVEN remains scenario setup, not a global seed override. Actions
    96	  and THEN results are not initial values. Follow inherited source rules; record
    97	  conflicts instead of silently choosing one shared state for incompatible cases.
    98	  The compact index supplies fact_ids, constraint_ids, scenario_precondition_ids,
    99	  scenario_seed_ids and unresolved source IDs. Query the frozen module's initial
   100	  context for provenance; do not repeatedly dump all of acceptance.json.
   101	  These are a conservative lexical aid, not a replacement for the original text.
   102	- Initialize an empty SQLite database at ARC_DB_FILE / DATABASE_FILE before health
   103	  becomes ready. Verify original seed requirements with cold-start API/browser tests.
   104	- A cold-start seed journey must not create its own missing declared records through
   105	  test-only SQL, private API helpers, or extra UI actions absent from the source.
   106	  Keep that journey separate from a user-created blank-object journey. If a lexical
   107	  index misses an explicit declaration, the original source still governs; document
   108	  the discrepancy rather than quietly redefining required initial state as test setup.
   109	- User-visible names are not durable initialization markers. Record the bootstrap
   110	  decision in persistent storage and make checking/provisioning atomic. Renames,
   111	  deletions, cleared data, credential changes and authorization revocations must not
   112	  be silently undone by another startup. Adopt prior user data without refilling it.
   113	  Verify a fresh application process using the same database after a real user
   114	  mutation; a browser reload alone does not verify initialization idempotency.
   115	- Independently check at least one original negative or cross-module journey after
   116	  each shared-state change. Use explicit per-operation permission lists rather than
   117	  assuming role names imply a cumulative privilege ladder. Preserve entire rejected
   118	  bulk operations, not only the last visible field. Record the exact tested scope;
   119	  internal green counts alone do not authorize an exhaustive or platform-score claim.
   120	- Preserve owner/child relations, status, counts, permissions and default visibility.
   121	  Scoped absence (an item is absent from ONE account's list) is not global absence.
   122	  Unsupported claims remain partial coverage; add focused cold-start API/browser
   123	  assertions derived from that original source. Do not claim a string scan proves
   124	  relationships or edit frozen facts to silence missing data.
   125	- For creation/cancellation, use a new record identity distinct from the required
   126	  existing one. Verify cancellation preserves the old record. Isolate test databases
   127	  so suites cannot overwrite the running application's initial state.
   128	
   129	## Names, containers and journeys
   130	
   131	- Preserve explicit names including whitespace/punctuation; comparisons ignore
   132	  case only. Avoid action suffixes, synonyms, translations, icon text or ellipsis
   133	  that change a required accessible name. The code auditor compares current YAML
   134	  and controller-approved visual text; no historic test fixture is an oracle.
   135	- If a name/role is reused with different meanings, associate the control with its
   136	  owning requirement via `data-req-id` and keep correct container scope. A string
   137	  occurring elsewhere does not prove that it names this control.
   138	- `.haiknow/ui-name-review.json` starts as `[]`. Only for an actually unnamed control,
   139	  add one object with file/name/kind="requirement_unnamed"/req_id/source_quote/reason.
   140	  Quote the relevant original requirement verbatim and explain the naming choice.
   141	  This is an unverified assumption, never permission to rename an explicit label.
   142	- In the existing progress.md, briefly map each original journey to GIVEN data,
   143	  scope/role/name, ordered actions, result/persistence, and actual test files. Keep
   144	  explicit requirements distinct from unspecified UI choices; no extra model phase.
   145	- Write expectations from original scenarios before choosing implementation details.
   146	  Playwright role/label locators need exact:true or fully anchored literal regex;
   147	  Testing Library string role names are already exact. Resolve one usable target
   148	  within its intended named form/dialog/record. Do not replace a failing locator
   149	  with global text, .first(), broad substring or test ID as the sole evidence.
   150	- Start each journey from its stated GIVEN and inherited source rules. Do not
   151	  add sign-in, permissions, setup actions or stronger initial states merely because
   152	  the application supports them. Authentication existing in another module does
   153	  not make every operation authenticated. Preserve all source-required access rules.
   154	  Test helpers must not silently supply extra preconditions that mask a failure;
   155	  reuse login only for journeys whose source requires that session.
   156	- Verify shared entry/navigation from a fresh browser. Follow the original actions (hover/open/select/save/
   157	  close/cancel/undo/refresh) without API shortcuts for the action being tested.
   158	  Avoid extra confirmations or assuming close saves. Check intermediate expanded,
   159	  selected and checked state, blur/submit timing, negative cases and persistence.
   160	- Include delayed-response checks of shared entry and state changes. Await the real
   161	  record/container with retrying assertions; never branch on one immediate isVisible
   162	  while data loads. No fixed sleeps, fabricated rows or disabled pagination.
   163	- Track coverage by original case ID, not the number of generated tests. Passing
   164	  self-written tests does not establish an official score or exhaustive correctness.
   165	
   166	## Cost control
   167	
   168	- After three recognized validation commands with unchanged source, the transport
   169	  requests an end-of-turn summary without tools. This does not certify a module;
   170	  independent full controller checks and bounded repair still follow. Prefer one
   171	  targeted test run per actual change. Do not repeat unchanged suites, create CPU
   172	  pressure, or put retries in a shell loop; diagnose failures and edit first.
   173	
   174	## Different-domain examples (never default product data)
   175	
   176	Suppose a future YAML says: click the "Authorize dispatch" button in the
   177	"Commission equipment" form. The form and button must keep those exact names;
   178	"Authorize dispatch now" is a mismatch. A route change does not turn the operation
   179	into a link. If it explicitly says the "Inspection history" link, use a link.
   180	
   181	Suppose Seed data specifies an operational machine "Kiln N8", while a recovery
   182	scenario GIVEN says it is retired. Keep the cold seed operational; retire it in that
   183	scenario’s setup before testing recovery. A GIVEN-only entity is scenario-local
   184	setup evidence, not an automatic instruction to pre-populate every installation.
   185	Verify each state in the actual application. A log line or unrelated record containing the same string is insufficient.
   186	These nouns and values are examples, not an entity whitelist.
